name: A costed sale links a cost reference with non-negative COGS; an uncosted sale carries null costed_ref and zero placeholder COGS so margin totals withhold.

payload.rationale: A costed sale links a cost reference with non-negative COGS; an uncosted sale carries null costed_ref and zero placeholder COGS so margin totals withhold.

response.expression: (((self.cost_status == 'costed') and (self.costed_ref != null)) and (self.cogs_amount >= 0)) or (((self.cost_status == 'missing_cost') and (self.costed_ref == null)) and (self.cogs_amount == 0))

payload.subject: supply.PosSale
